title: Identify the frequency relation
hints: Compare the result with each choice and check its sign, units, or underlying rule.
solution: $\nu=c/\lambda$ and $E=h\nu$, so both quantities are halved.
statement:
If wavelength in vacuum is doubled, what happens to frequency and photon energy?

[_]{a}

choices: Frequency halves and energy stays constant.
explanations: Both are inversely proportional to wavelength.
The photon energy depends on frequency.
